panels.description: The stolen barge disappears beyond the terraces. Alex lowers his hand; no alarm sounds. Leave sky and lake open.
The granddaughter kneels beside crooked TJ. Keep hands and damaged leg clear; leave upper space for dialogue.
TJ drags his damaged leg toward the boathouse, leaving wet marks. Leave upper area open.
Alex turns toward TJ at the edge of the boathouse light. Leave upper third clear.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Because I know what happens when people panic around water.
